run_text_guided_edit: run text-guided StyleGAN latent space optimization to edit generated images using a text description
run_cliploss: run CLIPLoss to compute similarity between generated images and text prompts using CLIP ViT-B/32
run_idloss: run IDLoss to compute facial identity similarity between generated and reference images using ArcFace
run_get_lr: run get_lr to compute cosine annealed learning rate with rampup and rampdown phases
run_main: run main CLI to optimize StyleGAN W-space latents guided by CLIP text loss with optional identity preservation
